title: B2B Social Media Specialist - Account Setup & Content Creator
description:
We are looking for a talented, results-driven Social Media Manager & Content Marketer to build the organic social media presence from scratch for our platform, ClinEd Network. We connect Nurse Practitioner students with independent clinical preceptors (NPs, PAs, MDs, Social Workers, Psychologists, Counselors) for their rotations.

This is a B2B-focused role. Your primary goal is to onboard licensed healthcare professionals to register as preceptors on our marketplace.

Unlike traditional clinical placement agencies that exploit students and pocket up to 60% of the revenue, ClinEd Network uses a revolutionary, transparent peer-to-peer model:



   1. Preceptors set their own rates and keep 100% of the student's direct payment.

   2. It is 100% free for them to list their profiles and bandwidth.

   3. We only charge a small platform fee after they review and accept a student's rotation request.



Your first task will be to set up and fully optimize all our brand new social media accounts (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok,
) before launching our organic content strategy.

## Key Responsibilities:



* Account Creation & Optimization: Set up clean, professional profiles across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and
. Write compelling bios, set up profile imagery, and build a unified "link-in-bio" landing menu.

* B2B Content Strategy: Research and create educational, high-authority organic content targeting clinicians (focusing on supplemental revenue, earning state-specific CEU/CME credits through teaching, and clinical efficiency).

* Graphic Design & Repurposing: Design clean, multi-slide LinkedIn carousels and professional infographics using Canva.

* Short-Form Video Production: Script and storyboard 30-second vertical videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok) addressing major clinician objections.

* Organic Growth & Community Outreach: Actively distribute content and engage within niche
 groups, LinkedIn comment sections, and healthcare professional forums.



## Hard Skills Required:



* Platform Setup Experience: Proven history of building and configuring business accounts across major social networks from scratch.

* B2B Copywriting: Ability to write with a polished, highly professional tone that appeals to NPs, PAs, MDs, Social Workers, Psychologists, Counselors

* Social Media Design: High proficiency in Canva to construct elegant, uncluttered medical tech assets.

* Short-Form Video Frameworks: Strong understanding of visual hooks, pacing, and video scripting.



## Salary & Work Logistics:



* Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week).

* Starting Salary: $600 – $900 USD / month (paid bi-weekly or monthly via Wise/PayPal).

* Hours: Flexible, but requires a few hours of overlap with US East Coast (EST) business hours for alignment meetings.



## How to Apply (Mandatory Steps):

To filter out automated bot applications, please reply via
 
 with the exact subject line: "ClinEd Network Specialist Found".

In your application, please include:



   1. A link to your portfolio showcasing professional graphic carousels (preferably B2B or tech-focused) and accounts you have managed or set up.

   2. A 2–3 sentence answer explaining why you think a private practice Psychologist would prefer a peer-to-peer marketplace over a traditional corporate placement agency.



Note: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a 2-Week Paid Trial Project to demonstrate their real-world copywriting and design capabilities before official hiring.

About Us

Our company believe retail owners should spend their time curating inventory, building communities, and scaling their brands—not drowning in spreadsheets and register tape.



Job Summary

We are seeking an organized, detail-obsessed Certified Bookkeeper (CB or CPB) to manage our daily financial operations. In this role, you will be the anchor of our financial records, ensuring every transaction is perfectly recorded, reconciled, and optimized.

Because you are certified, we trust you to look beyond simple data entry—we need someone who understands depreciation, can catch and correct ledger errors independently, and will collaborate seamlessly with our external CPA at tax time.

Financial Reporting: Generate monthly and quarterly balance sheets, profit & loss (P&L) statements, and cash flow reports for leadership.

Year-End Prep: Maintain pristine financial records throughout the year and prepare clean financial binders/exports for our CPA's tax filing.



Qualifications & Skills

Certification Required: Active Certified Bookkeeper (CB) credential or Certified Professional Bookkeeper (CPB).

Experience: [2–5+] years of full-charge bookkeeping experience.

Software Mastery: Advanced proficiency in [QuickBooks Online / Xero] and intermediate-to-advanced Microsoft Excel skills (vlookups, pivot tables).

Integrity: Absolute discretion when handling sensitive financial, payroll, and personnel data.

title: Content Producer & Creative Marketing Assistant
description:
About the Founder:

You'll be working directly with a multi-passionate Neurodivergent (AuDHD) founder who is an occupational therapist, keynote speaker, content creator, and neurodivergent creative based in Melbourne. She has a growing audience across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, an allied health practice she wants to scale, and a personal brand with serious untapped potential. She's full of ideas, has genuine talent across multiple lanes, and needs the right person to help turn that into consistent, strategic output. She's upfront about what she needs support with: staying consistent with content, managing brand and collaboration
s, and turning creative energy into structured marketing that actually grows both her personal brand and her practice. If you're someone who sees potential and gets genuinely excited about building something from the ground up, keep reading.



The Role

This is a creative, strategic, and execution-focused role. You won't just be completing tasks. You'll be actively contributing to the growth of two interconnected brands: a personal creator brand and an allied health practice. The founder needs someone who can deliver consistent, polished, high-quality work at pace, think independently, and bring ideas when they see opportunities.



Content Production & Video Editing:

Editing long-form YouTube videos and repurposing them into short-form clips for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts using CapCut. Creating on-brand, visually strong carousels, thumbnails, and graphics in Canva. Managing the full content pipeline from raw footage through to published post. Supporting podcast production, editing, and distribution across platforms. Maintaining and keeping the publishing rhythm steady.

The goal is simple: the founder creates the raw material, and you turn it into finished content that actually gets published.



Canva Design & Digital Products

Designing, building, and launching digital products (guides, workbooks, templates, toolkits, lead magnets, presentation slides) in Canva. Setting up sales pages, product listings, and
 marketing sequences to support launches. Bringing ideas for new products based on audience needs and market gaps. You need to be genuinely strong in Canva, not just "I can use Canva," but able to produce work that looks polished, modern, and on-brand with a good eye for layout, spacing, typography, and visual hierarchy.



Marketing & Growth Strategy:

Developing and executing social media strategies to grow the founder's personal brand, creator accounts, and allied health practice. Writing captions and post copy that sound warm, human, and engaging. Researching trends and adapting them in a way that fits the brand. Tracking content performance and suggesting improvements based on what's actually working. Supporting content across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Substack, and podcast. Lead generation for the practice, including identifying referral pathways and outreach to potential referrers and collaborators. 



Brand Outreach, Partnerships & Growth

Proactively identifying and pursuing brand partnerships, sponsorships, and collaboration opportunities. Reaching out to brands, managing inbound partnership
s, negotiating deals, and following up. Researching brands that are a good fit and maintaining a brand outreach tracker. Helping develop and maintain a media kit. Identifying sponsorship and paid collaboration opportunities. The right person understands that creators don't grow only by posting. They also grow through pitching, partnerships, networking, and consistent follow-up.



Website, Scheduling & Admin

Updating and maintaining the business website (Wix). Content scheduling using Metricool. Light admin related to outreach, brand communications, and keeping the content calendar on track. Organising Google Drive folders and creating simple systems for content and marketing workflows.

telephony logic. Most of what you'll touch is already built; your job is to

fix bugs, ship new features, and raise the overall quality bar. You should be

comfortable jumping between a Flutter screen and a Django webhook in the same

afternoon.



---

What You'll Work On



- Building and refining screens in Flutter across iOS and Android

- Maintaining and extending the Django backend — API endpoints, business

logic, database models

- Working with Twilio webhooks and TwiML to control call routing behavior

- Integrating with VAPI for AI voice assistant configuration and call handling

- Fixing real user-reported issues — onboarding flows, form validation,

settings UX

- Keeping the EC2 deployment stable and shipping updates without breaking

production





You're a Strong Fit If You



- Have shipped a Flutter app before — you know Dart, widget trees, and state

management doesn't intimidate you

- Have built or maintained a Django backend — models, views, REST APIs, ORM

queries

- Have worked with at least one telephony or communication API (Twilio,

Vonage, Bandwidth)

- Are comfortable reading and writing TwiML or similar call flow markup

- Can SSH into an EC2 instance, debug a running service, and deploy a fix

without hand-holding

- Move fast, write clean code, and communicate clearly about what's done and

what's blocked



---

Nice to Have



- Experience with VAPI or other AI voice platforms

- Familiarity with prompt engineering or LLM integrations

- Prior work on a consumer mobile app with real users



---

What We're Not Looking For



Someone who needs a fully specc'd ticket for every task. This codebase is

real, the bugs are real, and the users are real. You should be able to look at

a problem, understand the system, and figure out the fix.



---

Stack: Flutter · Dart · Python · Django · Twilio · VAPI · TwiML · AWS EC2





To Apply



Send a short note about something you've built — mobile, backend, or both —

and why this kind of product interests you. Links to work are more useful than

a resume.

The Role

We are looking for a Security Engineer who is an absolute force on the ticket queue.

This is not a button-pressing job. This is not for someone who escalates everything and waits to be told what to do. We need a technician who owns problems start to finish, thinks two steps ahead, and makes our boots-on-the-ground team in the US faster and more effective, not more dependent.

You will be the first line of fire every morning when our dental office managers arrive and start submitting issues. You will triage, resolve, escalate intelligently, and document, before most of our US team even has their coffee.

Your job is to make every other person on this team feel like they have a superpower.



Your Responsibilities



Own the ticket queue during your shift, triage, prioritize, and resolve with urgency

Handle Tier 2 and Tier 3 issues independently: networking, server, endpoint, M365, security, dental software integration

Support our on-site US engineers remotely , be the brain when they need one

Identify patterns in recurring issues and build toward permanent fixes, not band-aids

Maintain and contribute to our documentation in Hudu , if it isn't documented, fix that

Streamline internal processes , if something is inefficient, call it out and fix it

Communicate clearly with clients and internal team in written English





What You Must Have



10+ years of hands-on IT experience, with significant time inside a managed service provider

CCNA certification minimum , higher certifications (CCNP, MCSE, etc.) are a strong advantage

Deep experience with Microsoft 365 administration and security (Conditional Access, Entra ID, Defender, Exchange)

Strong Windows Server background , Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO, Hyper-V

Solid networking fundamentals , VLANs, routing, firewall policy, VPN

Experience working with RMM and PSA platforms in an MSP environment

Excellent written and spoken English , you will interface directly with clients via phone and in writing, and will be expected to handle client calls independently over time





Bonus Points



Familiarity with any of our stack: HaloPSA, NinjaRMM, Huntress, Hudu, Axcient, Domotz, UniFi

Experience with dental practice software (Eaglesoft, Dentrix, Curve, Sidexis, Dexis)

Experience supporting HIPAA-compliant environments

Experience with Microsoft Azure or AWS





What to Expect

Week 1: You get acquainted with our systems, our clients, our stack, and our standards. We will invest in getting you up to speed.

Week 2 onward: You are expected to show value. We will know quickly if you are the right person.

We are direct. If something isn't working, we will tell you. If you are performing, we will reward it. We are a strong team that works hard, communicates well, and takes care of each other. If you want a place where your skills are actually used and recognized, this is it.



What We Offer



Unlimited paid time off , we measure output, not hours

A team that actually values you , high standards go both ways; if you perform, you will be recognized and rewarded

Work with a specialized, fast-moving MSP that is ahead of the curve , not a stagnant shop with stale processes





A Word of Honesty

We have worked with talented engineers from the Philippines before and we are proud of those relationships. We are also being straight with you: we have had people attempt to coast , collect a paycheck, do the minimum, and treat this like easy money.

If that is what you are looking for, we are not the right fit and we would rather you know that now.



We work hard. We move fast. We hold each other to a high standard. If you want a place where that energy is matched and rewarded, you will thrive here. If you are looking for easy money, we can save you the trouble.



How to Apply

To be considered, you must submit a video application.

Apply directly on onlinejobs.ph with your resume and, in addition, record a Loom video under 2 minutes and send the link along with a quick note to 
 to be considered. Your video must begin with the words "Hey Mike" or your application will not be reviewed. This is a simple instruction. It tells us everything we need to know about whether you follow directions.



In your video, cover:



Your background and why you are qualified for this role

A specific example of a complex technical problem you solved independently at an MSP

How you are going to make an immediate impact on our team



We are not looking for someone who is available. We are looking for someone who is exceptional.



If that's you, apply.

mber in the Philippines with an engineering or mechanical design background to help with product design, drafting, research, and development of new agricultural products.

* Able to follow instructions carefully and ask thoughtful questions

* Strong attention to detail

* Comfortable taking rough ideas and turning them into practical designs

* Reliable, honest, and interested in a long-term full-time role

* Good written English communication skills



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Agricultural equipment

* Sheet metal design

* Structural steel design

* Trailer design

* Tanks, hoppers, bins, conveyors, sprayers, or feeders

* Hydraulic, pump, plumbing, or spray system layouts

* Creating bill of materials

title: Executive & Operations Assistant
description:
Executive & Operations Assistant — CERTUM Strategic Tax & Wealth Advisory

Full-Time | Remote | Immediate Start



About the Company

CERTUM is a premium tax and wealth advisory firm serving business owners, high-net-worth families, and sophisticated investors. We specialize in proactive tax architecture, wealth structuring, and advanced financial planning — not compliance work. Our clients come to us when they're ready to play at a different level.



Beyond advisory, CERTUM operates a fast-growing media platform generating millions of views per month. We produce short-form and long-form video content, podcasts, workshops, seminars, and live webinars across the tax, wealth, and insurance niche. We also get paid to market other companies' products to our audience through brand partnerships — making content both a platform and a revenue line.



The company spans multiple verticals including tax advisory, real estate, and insurance — and is actively scaling across all of them.



About the Role

You will work one-on-one with the founder, Jamal Hansen — a successful entrepreneur managing multiple companies across tax, real estate, and insurance. Your job is to manage his responsibilities so he can stay focused on the highest-leverage work.

This is not a traditional assistant role. Jamal is traveling bi-weekly, running live events, recording content, and serving premium clients simultaneously. You need to be the person who keeps everything moving when he's in rooms, on stages, and in transit. If you need constant direction, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and take ownership without being asked, keep reading.



As the company grows, this role will grow with it. You will be taught new skills and take on new responsibilities over time — but you have to be coachable and genuinely eager to learn. The skills you'll develop working inside a multi-company operation spanning tax, real estate, insurance, and media are not things you'll pick up anywhere else. We're looking for world-class A-players who want to build something and grow with the company long-term.

This role is vital to the next evolution of the company.



What You'll Own



Inbox Management — Triage daily, respond to routine correspondence, flag priority items, and draft responses for review

Appointment Setting — Schedule across
, text, and phone; manage the calendar around bi-weekly travel, workshops, seminars, and webinars

Client & Prospect Communication — Speak directly with clients and prospects on behalf of Jamal via phone, text, and

Client Log Books — Maintain and update client-facing records and activity logs on behalf of the founder

Workshop, Seminar & Webinar Support — Coordinate registrations, attendee communications, reminder sequences, and day-of logistics

Client Fulfillment Support — Assist with onboarding, document routing, follow-ups, and status tracking across active clients

Daily Video Publishing — Post videos across all platforms every day including YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
, and X — on time, correctly formatted, with the right captions, hashtags, and thumbnails

Content Reposting — Repurpose and repost existing content across platforms to maximize reach and keep all channels consistently active

Payroll Assistance — Support payroll processing, track hours, and handle submissions across the company's entities

Administrative & Operational Support — Manage day-to-day operational tasks across multiple business lines as directed





Who You Are



You speak and write in fluent, professional English — clients and prospects will interact with you directly, and first impressions matter

You communicate with confidence and polish, whether on a phone call, a text thread, or a formal

You are coachable — you take feedback well, implement it quickly, and don't have an ego about learning something new

You are hungry to grow — you see new responsibilities as opportunities, not inconveniences

You operate independently and don't need hand-holding to figure out what needs to get done

You're systems-oriented and build repeatable processes so nothing falls through the cracks

You can juggle competing priorities across multiple companies without dropping the ball

You take full ownership of your responsibilities

You're an A-player who wants to be part of something bigger than a job title

You're comfortable in a fast-moving, growth-stage environment where the pace is real





Requirements



Fluent English speaker with excellent verbal and written communication skills — this is non-negotiable as you will be the voice of the brand with clients and prospects

2+ years supporting a founder, executive, or entrepreneur in an operations or assistant capacity

Strong written communication — clear, professional, and concise

Proficiency with Google Workspace and calendar management tools

Experience posting and managing content across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok,
, and X

Familiarity with scheduling and content management tools (Buffer, Metricool, or similar)

Experience coordinating events, travel, or client-facing operations

CRM experience a plus (GoHighLevel preferred)

Payroll or light bookkeeping familiarity a plus

Available and responsive during business hours with flexibility around live events and travel weeks





Why This Role

You'll have direct access to a founder operating across multiple industries — tax, real estate, and insurance — with a media platform that reaches millions of people a month. You won't be buried in a corporate structure. You'll be in the room, seeing how a multi-company operation runs at a high level, and growing with it.

There is real room to grow here for someone who performs.

Apply directly using the link below and complete the application form:

This role is equal parts platform expert, community manager, and analyst. You don't need to create the content, we have a 13-editor engine for that, but you do need to know each platform deeply and how to make content perform on it.



Deep, current expertise in how YouTube, Instagram, and
 actually work, algorithms, formats, distribution, and platform-specific best practices, this is the single most important thing we're looking for

Strong written English and clear communication, you'll be working directly with the director

LinkedIn personal-brand management experience is a bonus, not a requirement



What We Offer



$1,200–$1,600 USD/month, depending on experience, with room above for the right person who can also manage the director's LinkedIn

Fully remote, work from anywhere in the Philippines

A content engine of 13 editors already in motion, so you're set up to focus on distribution, engagement, and performance, not starting from zero

Direct access to the director, and a company that builds custom dashboards, automations, and tools across every department to make your job easier

A fast-growing agency with clear processes and a genuine opportunity to grow as our brand scales

The chance to own and build a presence from a strong foundation, and play a direct role in the content that brings new clients through the door

The OPT Digital Team

title: Full-Time Video Editor & AI Content Creator
description:
Background



We’re a fast-growing social media agency producing high-performing short-form content across Instagram,
, YouTube, and more. WE’RE SCALING FAST!!



This isn't just a job. As the agency grows, the team grows with it. More clients means more volume, higher bonuses, and bigger opportunities for the people who helped build it. We believe in rewarding the people who show up, execute well, and grow with us and we're looking for someone who wants to be part of that from the ground floor.



We’re hiring a full-time AI Video Specialist to create raw AI clips and assemble them into polished short-form videos using our internal workflows.



This is an execution role. Not strategy.

You’ll be given clear briefs, proven systems, and step-by-step Standard Operating Procedures (SOP's) for every task.



If you haven't used every tool on our stack yet, that's okay we'll teach the right person.



What You'll Do



Video Editing

- Turn raw footage into high-retention short-form content (Reels, TikToks, Shorts)

- Add captions, overlays, transitions, sound design, and B-roll in CapCut

- Follow brand guidelines and client briefs exactly

- Apply feedback quickly and accurately

- Deliver a consistent daily output, on time

- Maintain brand consistency across multiple client accounts



AI Clip Generation

- Generate AI video assets using tools like ChatGPT, Grok, and Veo3

- Execute SOPs precisely (prompts, settings, formats are predefined)

- Quality check all outputs (accuracy, artifacts, exports) before submission

- Flag issues and gaps to improve workflows

- Organize and label all assets clearly for handoff



General

- Manage multiple client projects without missing deadlines

- Keep files structured and easy to navigate

- Communicate proactively on progress, timelines, and blockers



Requirements



Must-Haves

- GROWTH MINDSET AND HUNGRY TO LEARN!!!!

- Strong proficiency in English (speaking, reading, writing)

- Experience editing short-form content - PORTFOLIO REQUIRED

- Experience prompting AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.)

- Strong proficiency in CapCut

- High attention to detail and quality

- Comfortable following SOPs (execute first, revise/polish second)

- Able to manage multiple projects without missing deadlines

- Reliable internet and dedicated workspace

- Coachable, fast learner, and willing to adopt new tools

- Currently working with NO OTHER CLIENTS. All work commitment should be on this role.



Nice-to-Haves

- Agency or content production background

- Strong understanding of short-form performance (hooks, pacing, retention)

- Copywriting experience

- Strong WiFi



What We Offer

- Stable, full-time remote role with consistent workload

- Clear SOPs and briefs, no guesswork

- Training on AI tools for the right candidate

- Direct, respectful communication and fast feedback

- Growth opportunities as we scale

- Performance bonuses of up to 40% of monthly pay (If you perform exceptionally well, we will add on top ANOTHER bonus)

- Access to required tools



How to Apply



Include all of the following. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE REVIEWED:

- Portfolio or reel (Drive, Notion, or direct links)

- 2–3 short-form content edits (tiktoks, reels, yt shorts, etc.)

- Short answer (3–5 sentences): What do you do when an SOP is unclear?

- Your timezone + working hours



No portfolio = no review.

description:

30 hrs/week | Monday–Friday | EST Hours (8am–5pm available)





ABOUT US



Superb Concepts is a fast-growing landscape design-build and hardscape company in Northeast Ohio. We build high-end outdoor living spaces — patios, fire pits, retaining walls, drainage systems, and decorative concrete. We run a real operating system with documented SOPs, digital job tracking, CRM automations, and structured reporting.



We are growing and we need someone sharp, organized, and proactive to own the administrative and communications side of the business so our leadership can stay focused on sales and production.



This role starts at 30 hours per week. For the right person who proves themselves, we will add responsibilities and grow your hours to full time. We are not looking for someone to fill a seat — we are looking for someone to grow with us.





SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY



This role is 30 hours per week — 6 hours per day, Monday through Friday. You must be available and reachable from 8am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time every workday. This means being at your desk, answering calls and messages in real time during those hours — not clocking 6 hours whenever it's convenient.



We serve US customers who call, text, and
 during business hours. You are their first point of contact. Availability is not optional.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



This is not a light task list. You are the operational backbone of the office.



DAILY:

• Answer and return all inbound calls, texts, and
s same day

• Enter new leads and customer requests into our CRM (GoHighLevel) and job software (SynkedUp)

• Manage job schedule and Google Calendar

• Follow up on all open quotes and web requests

• Update our job readiness tracker and active jobs board (Google Sheets)

• Move contacts through the GHL pipeline as jobs progress

• Screen job applicants — call Indeed candidates daily, fill out interview sheet, send summary to owner

• Post daily EOD summary to owner



WEEKLY:

• Input receipts and deposits into QuickBooks

• Verify employee card transactions — flag anything unusual

• Post to Google My Business,
, and Instagram (2x/week)

• Give feedback on Google LSA ad calls

• Send invoices and follow up on unpaid balances



MONTHLY:

• Run job costing, marketing spend, and estimate conversion reports in SynkedUp

• Place stock orders (build Amazon cart, get owner approval, purchase and track)

• Post to 
munity groups for marketing

• Chase unpaid invoices



AS NEEDED:

• Employee onboarding and offboarding paperwork

• DOT and insurance admin tasks

• Renewing vehicle registrations and tags

• Canceling or managing subscriptions

• Supporting the owner with task organization and daily planning





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



REQUIRED:

2+ years experience as a VA or in admin/operations

Excellent written and spoken English — you will speak with US customers on the phone daily

Proficient in Google Workspace — Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Calendar

Experience with AI tools — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar (required)

Fast learner with new software — we use multiple platforms and you need to get up to speed quickly

Highly organized and self-directed — you manage your own task list without being reminded

Available 8am–5pm EST Monday–Friday — non-negotiable

Willing to use Time Doctor for time tracking (required — see below)



PREFERRED:

Experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) or any CRM platform

QuickBooks experience

Experience in construction, trades, landscaping, or home services

Experience building automations or using AI to eliminate repetitive tasks



TIME TRACKING & SCREEN MONITORING

We use Time Doctor for all remote staff. This is required from Day 1 and non-negotiable.



Time Doctor runs during your scheduled work hours and:

• Tracks your active work time

• Takes periodic random screenshots during work sessions

• Monitors which apps and websites are open during work hours

• Reports your daily activity level to ownership



This is not about distrust — it is about accountability and making sure you are set up for success. Every serious VA we have spoken with is already familiar with this. If you are not comfortable with it, this role is not the right fit.





WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE



The right person does not wait to be told what to do. They see a task that needs doing and they handle it. They use AI to draft communications, organize information, and eliminate repetitive work. They treat this role like they own the office — because they do.



If your idea of a productive day is a cleared inbox, every lead followed up, every system updated, and one thing made more efficient than yesterday — this is your role.



We are a growing company and we invest in people who invest in us. The right person will have more responsibility, more hours, and more opportunity within 90 days.



COMPENSATION & DETAILS



• $5–$6 USD/hour based on experience ($600–$720/month at 30 hrs/week)

• 30 hours/week to start — 6 hours/day, Monday–Friday

• Opportunity to grow to 40 hours/week for the right person

• Must be available and reachable 8am–5pm EST — active availability, not flexible clocking

• Paid weekly via Wise or PayPal

• Time Doctor provided and required from Day 1

• Long-term position — we are building a company, not filling a temp role

• Direct access to ownership — you will work closely with Tyler (President) daily





HOW TO APPLY



Send your application with the subject line: "SC VA — [Your Name]"



In your message, answer both of these questions. Do not skip them.



1. Describe a time you used an AI tool to save time on a repetitive task. What was the task, what tool did you use, and what was the result?



2. You arrive at your desk Monday morning and see 12 missed calls, 8 unanswered texts, and 6 new
 inquiries. Walk me through exactly how you handle it — step by step.



Applications without answers to both questions will not be reviewed. Your answers tell us everything we need to know about how you work.

title: Long-Term Zendesk Customer Support & Live Chat Coverage Specialist, 7 Days/Week
description:

This is NOT a short-term freelance project. We are looking for one dependable person who wants stable, long-term work and can grow with our company, for years to come.



The role is a flexible customer support coverage position. The active workload is usually around 2-3 hours per day, but we need dependable coverage throughout the U.S. business day because customers can submit support tickets or live chat messages at different times.



You are NOT expected to sit at your computer nonstop all day, but you must be reliable, responsive, and able to check Zendesk regularly throughout the coverage window.



This is a U.S. Pacific Time schedule, which may be overnight/graveyard hours in the Philippines. Please only apply if you are comfortable with this schedule long-term.



Compensation:

$1,000 USD per month

This role requires 7-day coverage, including weekends.



Coverage window:

6 AM to 8 PM U.S. Pacific Time, 7 days/week

7 AM to 7 PM U.S. Pacific Time

Usually around 2 hours per day

What You Will Do

Refunds

Legal threats

BBB complaints or threats

Angry or aggressive customers

Warranty disputes

Defective product claims

Technical installation confusion

Address changes after order placement

Any situation where you are unsure what to say



Good judgment is very important. We would rather you escalate a sensitive issue than guess.



Requirements



The ideal candidate must have:

Excellent written English

Customer support experience

Zendesk experience preferred

Live chat experience preferred

E-commerce experience preferred

Shopify experience is a plus

Strong attention to detail

Calm and professional writing style

Reliable internet connection

Ability to work independently

Ability to follow company policies carefully

Comfortable with U.S. Pacific Time coverage

Comfortable with 7-day flexible coverage

Important Personality Traits



We are looking for someone who is:

Reliable

Honest

Detail-oriented

Calm under pressure

Good with upset customers

Professional but friendly

Careful with company policies

Comfortable asking questions

Able to work long-term without needing constant supervision



This role is not just about answering tickets quickly. We need someone who can protect the customer experience while also following company policies.



What This Role Is Not



This is not a phone support role.

This is not a sales cold-calling role.

This is not a short-term project.

This is not a nonstop 8-hour desk job.

This is not a role where you can ignore notifications for several hours.



The active workload is light to moderate, but responsiveness is important.



Daily Expectations



A typical day may look like this:



Check Zendesk in the morning for new tickets

Reply to simple customer questions

Monitor live chat notifications

Check Zendesk every 30–60 minutes during the coverage window

Handle easy tickets as they come in

Escalate complicated tickets

Do a final ticket check near the end of the coverage window

Send a short daily summary if needed



How to Apply

Whether you have used Zendesk before

Whether you have handled live chat before

Customer:

Please write the response you would send to the customer.

The most important qualities for this role are:

Reliability

Responsiveness

Good written English

Strong judgment

Ability to follow instructions

Long-term commitment



We are looking for someone who can become a trusted part of our business, for many years to come.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) Product Sourcer / VA
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Amazon Virtual Assistant specializing in Online Arbitrage (OA) sourcing. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the Amazon US marketplace and be highly proficient in identifying consistently profitable products. For this role, you will be required to use Keepa and SellerAmp exclusively to source, analyze, and validate leads.



Your primary responsibility will be to find high-quality leads that meet our strict criteria. Every product you source must yield a minimum of 30% ROI and at least $3 net profit per unit. Furthermore, we need items with a proven sales velocity of 50+ sales per month. It is crucial that you understand how to evaluate listing saturation and competition. For example, if an item sells 50 units a month but currently has 10 competitive sellers, that is a bad lead because the shared volume is too low. When you apply, please make sure to put the word banana in the subject line so I know you have read this entire description thoroughly. We need someone who can independently analyze Keepa charts to avoid tanking prices, high return rates, and IP complaints.



Please note that this is a full-time position. All shortlisted candidates will be subject to a trial run to demonstrate their sourcing skills and adherence to our specific metrics before a permanent offer is made.

title: Senior Video Editor / Lead Editor
description:
Senior Video Editor / Lead Editor — Job Description Outline

Position Title



Senior Video Editor / Lead Editor



Position Overview



We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Video Editor who can lead post-production workflows from ingest to final delivery. This role requires advanced expertise in Adobe Premiere Pro, strong leadership abilities, high-level color grading and creative storytelling skills, and the ability to troubleshoot and salvage imperfect footage captured in fast-paced production environments.



The ideal candidate is dependable under pressure, thrives in unconventional schedules when deadlines demand it, and can manage both creative direction and technical execution across multiple projects.









Trial Edit & Hiring Process



All applicants will be required to complete a challenging trial editing task before being considered for the role.



This test is intentionally designed to reflect real production conditions and evaluate:



Editing ability

Creative decision-making

Storytelling

Audio balancing

Color grading

Workflow organization

Problem-solving under pressure



We are looking for editors who can produce polished, professional-level work — not rushed edits with generic templates, automated captions, or low-effort effects. Submissions that appear careless, unfinished, or overly reliant on drag-and-drop editing styles will not qualify for payment or further consideration.



The trial task is paid only if the submission demonstrates strong effort, quality execution, and professional editing standards.



We keep the test difficult on purpose because we are only looking to bring on highly capable editors who can operate at a high level consistently.



Editors who successfully complete the onboarding process and become part of the team will have opportunities for increased pay, larger responsibilities, and long-term growth within the company.















Key Responsibilities

Editing & Post-Production

Lead the editing process for commercial, branded, documentary, social, and cinematic video content

Manage complete Premiere Pro workflows including:

Project organization

Media ingest

Proxy workflows

Timeline management

Multicam editing

Sound syncing

Final exports and delivery

Deliver polished edits under tight deadlines

Maintain consistent pacing, storytelling, and visual quality

Leadership & Team Management

Act as Lead Editor on productions and post-production teams

Oversee junior editors and assistant editors

Maintain project timelines and ensure efficient workflow execution

Collaborate with producers, directors, cinematographers, and creative teams

Provide feedback and creative direction during post-production

Color Grading & Creative Enhancement

Perform advanced color correction and cinematic color grading

Match footage from multiple cameras and inconsistent shooting environments

Enhance visual tone, mood, and brand consistency

Create stylized looks when needed for campaigns or creative projects

Problem Solving / Footage Recovery

Troubleshoot and repair common production issues including:

Poor exposure

Bad white balance

Audio issues

Shaky footage

Framing mistakes

Inconsistent camera settings

Salvage problematic footage and turn difficult shoots into usable final products

Identify technical issues early and propose solutions quickly

Workflow & Technical Operations

Maintain organized project archives and media management systems

Optimize workflows for speed and collaboration

Handle exports for web, broadcast, social media, and client delivery

Stay current with editing trends, plugins, codecs, and industry standards



Required Qualifications

3+ years of professional video editing experience

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro

Strong understanding of post-production workflows

Advanced color grading and correction experience

Experience leading editing teams or post-production departments

Excellent storytelling instincts and editing rhythm

Strong communication and organizational skills

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with:

Adobe After Effects

DaVinci Resolve

Adobe Audition

Motion graphics and sound design experience

Knowledge of camera codecs and production workflows

Experience working in fast-paced production environments



Work Schedule Expectations

Must be flexible and available to work unconventional hours when production deadlines require it

Ability to handle late-night edits, rapid turnarounds, and occasional weekend work

Comfortable operating in high-pressure environments with shifting priorities

Ideal Candidate Traits

Calm under pressure

Highly detail-oriented

Creative problem solver

Strong leadership presence

Technically advanced editor

Adaptable and resourceful

Passionate about cinematic storytelling and visual quality

Deliverables / Expectations

High-quality edits delivered on schedule

Consistent visual and storytelling standards

Efficient management of post-production workflow

Ability to rescue difficult footage and maintain professional final output

title: AIRBNB VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — OPERATIONS & COLD CALLING
description:
**AIRBNB VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — OPERATIONS & COLD CALLING**

Haven Noire | Full-Time | 5+ Years STR Experience Required



---



**THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL ROLE. IF YOU DO NOT HAVE AIRBNB OR SHORT-TERM RENTAL EXPERIENCE, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.**



---



**QUICK FACTS**

- Type: Full-time, Remote

- Hours: 30 hrs/week | 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM Mountain Standard Time | Weekends required

- Pay: $2.00/hr base + uncapped commission per signed arbitrage deal

- Experience: Minimum 5 years Airbnb / short-term rental management

- Cold Calling: 80–150+ outbound calls/day required

- Start: Immediate



---



**ABOUT US**



Haven Noire is a newly formed US-based short-term rental company building a portfolio of Airbnb arbitrage and co-managed properties across multiple US markets. We are in active growth mode — you are joining early, and your performance directly shapes how fast we scale and how much you earn.



We need someone who can do two things well: run flawless STR operations AND get on the phone to bring new properties into our portfolio. If you are a closer who also knows Airbnb inside out, this role was written for you.



---



**THE ROLE**



This is a dual-function position. You will own both sides of our operation: securing new properties through outbound cold calling, and running day-to-day Airbnb operations once those properties are live.



---



**PART 1 — BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & COLD CALLING**



Because we are a new operation, securing properties is the first priority. You will be the first voice property owners hear from Haven Noire. Your phone performance directly drives your commission — there is no cap.



What you will do:

- 80–150+ outbound cold calls daily to US property owners and landlords

- Pitch Haven Noire's Airbnb arbitrage and co-management services

- Qualify leads and book appointments for deal closing

- Follow up with warm leads via call, SMS, and

- Maintain clean CRM notes after every call

- Research target markets and build prospect lists based on our criteria

- Draft and send arbitrage pitch letters and follow-up sequences



Cold calling requirements:

- Excellent spoken English — clear, natural flow, light or neutral accent. Non-negotiable.

- Previous cold calling experience: real estate, SaaS, insurance, or similar outbound roles

- Experience with dialers: Mojo, CallTools, RingCentral, or equivalent

- Experience with CRMs: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or equivalent

- Thick skin and self-motivation

- Reliable internet (25+ Mbps), noise-canceling headset, quiet workspace



---



**PART 2 — AIRBNB & STR OPERATIONS**



Once properties are signed, you manage our listings end-to-end: guests, cleaners, maintenance, platform health, and account protection.



Guest communication:

- Handle all guest messaging: pre-booking, during stay, post-checkout

- Respond within Airbnb SLA windows to protect Superhost status

- Manage booking requests, special needs, and issue resolution



Turnover & maintenance:

- Coordinate cleaners to ensure on-time turnovers between every booking

- Schedule and track maintenance requests with vendors and building staff

- Monitor property tech: Ring cameras, smart locks, noise monitors



Platform & account management:

- Handle Airbnb support tickets, case escalations, and claim negotiations

- Manage listing health: pricing, availability, photos, and descriptions

- Submit review removal requests when warranted, manage review responses

- Protect host accounts from flags, suspensions, or policy violations



Reporting:

- Maintain daily logs of guest status, cleaning schedules, and open issues

- Weekly reporting on occupancy, revenue, and operational flags



---



**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**



You must meet all of the following. No exceptions.



- Minimum 5 years of direct Airbnb or short-term rental management experience

- Proven portfolio — you must be able to show listings you have managed (URLs, screenshots, or references)

- Deep knowledge of Airbnb platform policies, terms of service, and case management

- Experience communicating with Airbnb support and resolving escalations

- Strong written English for guest-facing communication

- Excellent spoken English for cold calling — natural, clear, confident

- Prior outbound cold calling experience with measurable results

- Available 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM Mountain Standard Time, including weekends

- Reliable internet 25+ Mbps, headset, quiet workspace



---



**BONUS QUALIFICATIONS (not required)**



- Experience as an Airbnb case manager or platform specialist

- Managed 20+ active listings simultaneously

- Cold calling experience in real estate, property management, or Airbnb arbitrage

- Mid-term rental strategy experience (30-day stays, travel nurses, corporate)

- Familiar with Hospitable, Guesty, PriceLabs, Turno, or similar tools



---



**COMPENSATION**



Base: $2.00/hour. Commission: uncapped — every arbitrage deal you help close earns you a bonus on top of your base. As the portfolio grows, your base rate grows with it.



We are a new business and the base reflects that honestly. What we offer in return is an early seat at a scaling company, direct impact on your own earnings, and a commitment to raising your rate as you prove your value. Closers who perform will not stay at base for long.



---



**HOW TO APPLY — READ THIS CAREFULLY**



Applications missing any of the five items below will not be reviewed. No exceptions.



1. Voice memo (2–3 min) in English: introduce yourself, walk through your cold calling background, share your biggest phone win, and explain why commission-based work motivates you.

2. Written summary of your cold calling experience — industries, daily dial volume, conversion rates, appointments booked. Be specific with numbers.

3. Proof of Airbnb/STR experience — listing URLs, dashboard screenshots, or verifiable client references.

4. Internet speed test screenshot showing 25+ Mbps.

5. Your expected base salary and any past commission structures you have earned under.



Subject line: **"I dial, I close — [Your Name]"**



Write **"HAVEN NOIRE READY"** at the top of your message to confirm you read this posting in full.



Incomplete applications will not receive a response.

Strong written English (Airbnb Support operates in English).

Comfortable tracking dozens of open cases at once.

title: 3D Modeling/CAD Designer
description:
Speed Industries is looking for a skilled Virtual Assistant with strong 3D modeling and CAD design experience to support our fabrication, laser cutting, powder coating, and product development work.



This role is ideal for someone who understands manufacturing, can take rough ideas or marked-up drawings and turn them into clean, usable CAD files, and can help reduce the design workload for our internal team. The right person will be detail-oriented, organized, responsive, and comfortable working remotely with a fast-moving fabrication company.



The primary focus of this position will be creating, revising, and preparing 3D models, 2D drawings, flat patterns, and production-ready design files for manufacturing.



Key Responsibilities

3D Modeling & CAD Design



Create and revise 3D models for fabricated parts, assemblies, brackets, guards, frames, fixtures, signs, and customer products.



Develop CAD models from sketches, photos, measurements, customer drawings, or verbal direction.



Prepare clean and accurate part files for CNC laser cutting, tube laser cutting, press brake forming, welding, and powder coating.



Create and update 2D drawings with dimensions, notes, material callouts, bend details, hole sizes, tolerances, and revision history.



Generate flat patterns, DXF files, STEP files, PDF drawings, and other required production files.



Assist with converting customer-supplied files into usable manufacturing drawings.



Check designs for manufacturability, including bend allowances, material thickness, hole spacing, weld access, hardware clearance, and powder coating considerations.



Drawing Packages & Revisions



Prepare professional drawing packages for shop use and customer approval.



Revise existing drawings based on feedback from customers, shop employees, or management.



Maintain organized file naming, folder structure, and version control.



Clearly mark changes and communicate revision updates.



Help standardize Speed Fabrication’s drawing templates, title blocks, notes, and CAD file organization.



Manufacturing Support



Work with Speed Fabrication’s team to help translate ideas into buildable products.



Support laser cutting, fabrication, and powder coating projects with accurate CAD files.



Assist with product development for online products, Shopify items, Etsy products, customer jobs, and repeat manufacturing work.



Identify potential design issues before parts reach the shop floor.



Help create repeatable designs that improve efficiency and reduce rework.



Required Skills



Strong experience with 3D CAD software such as:



Fusion 360

SolidWorks

Inventor

AutoCAD

Onshape

or similar professional CAD software



Ability to create accurate 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings.



Ability to export DXF, STEP, PDF, STL, and other common file types.



Understanding of sheet metal design, bend lines, flat patterns, material thickness, and formed parts.



Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.



Strong attention to detail.



Good written communication skills.



Ability to follow directions, ask smart questions, and work independently.



Reliable internet connection and ability to work remotely.



Ability to organize files clearly and consistently.



Preferred Experience



Experience designing parts for CNC laser cutting.



Experience with press brake forming and sheet metal fabrication.



Experience with tube laser or structural fabrication.



Experience creating weldment drawings or fabrication assemblies.



Experience designing products for powder coating.



Experience working with American units: inches, fractions, decimals, gauges, and material thicknesses.



Experience creating customer approval drawings.



Experience with manufacturing businesses, job shops, or custom fabrication companies.



Basic understanding of hardware, fasteners, weld symbols, tabs, slots, bend reliefs, and tolerances.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is not just a CAD operator. They are someone who thinks through how a part will actually be made.



They should be able to take an idea like, “We need a bracket that bolts here and holds this panel,” and turn it into a clean model and drawing that the shop can manufacture with minimal back-and-forth.



They should be organized, responsive, and capable of working with limited information while still knowing when to ask questions.



Typical Projects



Examples of work may include:



Sheet metal brackets

Laser-cut parts

Welded assemblies

Guards and covers

Custom signs

Product prototypes

Customer-supplied drawing cleanup

DXF file preparation

Fixtures and shop tooling

Repeat manufacturing parts

Assembly drawings

Flat patterns for laser cutting and bending

Software Requirements



Candidate should have access to professional CAD software or be willing to work within Speed Fabrication’s preferred CAD workflow.



Preferred software: Fusion 360, but other platforms may be acceptable depending on experience and file compatibility.



Required export formats:



DXF

STEP

PDF

STL when needed

Native CAD files when applicable

Communication & Workflow



This is a remote position. Communication may happen through
, phone, text, shared folders, project management software, or video calls.



The candidate must be able to:



Review project instructions

Ask clarifying questions

Provide estimated completion times

Submit clean files

Make revisions quickly

Keep files organized

Communicate when something is unclear or not manufacturable

Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, speed, accuracy, and ability to produce manufacturing-ready work.



Possible structures include:



Hourly

Per project

Part-time contract

Trial period with growth potential

Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



Accuracy of CAD models and drawings

Speed of turnaround

Low number of revision errors

Clear communication

Ability to understand fabrication requirements

Clean file organization

Ability to reduce workload from Speed Fabrication’s internal team

Ability to create files that can move directly into production

A skilled Static Designer who is also a true AI image generation wizard.

Your mission:

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist
description:

title: Senior Video Editor - Direct Response Performance Ads - Headlamp Brand
description:
Senior Video Editor - Direct Response Performance Ads - Headlamp Brand



Job Overview

We're a fast-growing headlamp brand, already one of the biggest in our category and scaling hard into the US to become the biggest globally. We scale through Meta paid ads and we're building our in-house creative team for the rest of 2026 and beyond.

We're looking for a video editor to join us. This is a long-term collaborative role with strong base pay, real performance bonuses on winning ads, and a clear growth path if you're an A-player.

Full-time preferred. Part-time considered for the right editor with strong availability through Q4.



About Us

We sell a product that genuinely makes people's lives better. The brand is founder-led, performance-driven, and growing fast. We have the strategy, the briefs, the creators, and the system already in place. What we need now is the right editor to execute at the level the brand and team deserves.

We're scaling our ad spend significantly through Q4, which means we need editors who can deliver clean, high-converting direct response ads at speed without compromising quality.

Focused on understanding the stories and narratives we create and turning them into great ads. 



What You'll Be Doing

You'll be editing UGC ads, Voiceover ads, founder-style content, mashups, and AI-assisted ads - all designed to convert. The output is direct response performance creative, not branded content. We care about hooks, retention, pacing, narrative, and clarity. The ads that spend the most for us are simple, natural, and don't feel like ads at all.

A big part of the role is reviewing our top-spending ads, understanding why they work, and using that to iterate on what we make next. We build feedback loops here - every brief is better than the last, and every editor on the team gets sharper with each ad they cut. You'll have briefs, creator footage, and the support of the team to do your best work.

You'll work directly with the team to learn and improve what's working to drive the quality in the right direction. Communication is in English via Slack.



What We're Looking For

An editor who understands narrative, story, and direct response - and can read the type of ad and the concept we've built, and edit it in the way that fits it best. Creating ads that resonate with REAL PEOPLE. 

Specifically:

- Strong portfolio of DTC/eCommerce ads that genuinely performed on Meta or TikTok

- Deep understanding of hook craft, retention, pacing, and how ads convert

- Fluent in UGC editing - clean, natural, organic feel

- Experience in mashup, founder-style, and ugly ads

- AI-fluent - we use ElevenLabs for voiceover, Higgsfield for AI B-roll, Nano Banana for images, and we're always exploring new tools

- High-level written and spoken English

- Reliable, communicative, takes feedback well, delivers on time

- Able to deliver finished ads at a steady pace - typically 2-3 per day at peak (more if possible). 

- Cares about quality and craft, not just output volume

We're pro-AI here. We still love real content and real creators - AI helps the workflow and the output. If you can combine craft with speed and AI fluency, you'll thrive here.



What This Pays

Base rate: $35 USD per finished ad.



Paid per brief delivered to standard. Strong volume of briefs available, especially through Q4.



Plus performance bonuses on winning ads.



We pay real bonuses when ads you cut scale. Our top ads last year individually spent over $100,000+ each - and Q4 is when the biggest bonuses get paid out. The structure is genuinely favourable: editors who deliver winners can earn meaningful additional income on top of base, especially during the Q4 ramp.



Full bonus structure shared once you pass the paid test brief.



Growth Path

This is a long-term role. The editor who delivers in Q4 becomes the senior editor on the team in 2027. Real progression - more responsibility, higher rates, leadership of newer editors, and direct collaboration on creative direction.



How to Apply

We're running a structured application process. Don't reply to this post - applications go through our application form here:





The form takes 10-15 minutes. We're looking for editors who take it seriously and answer in their own words. 



If you're a strong fit, we'll come back to you with a paid test brief using real footage from the brand and creators. From there, the right editor joins the team and starts cutting paid work within the week.



A Final Word

An editor who chases volume and doesn't care about hook craft, engagement, or story - we're not the brand for you.

If you're an editor who cares about every cut, every caption, every beat - who wants to be part of a serious team building one of the biggest brands in our space - apply through the form. We'll come back to you.

ments that read naturally to an American audience. We will test this in the application.

 groups, or community management

description:
SENIOR SOCIAL MEDIA CONTENT MANAGER — LUXURY & LIFESTYLE

Noxu Media Group | Remote | $1,000 – $1,500 USD/month based on experience

================================================================

 

 

QUICK OVERVIEW

--------------

Company:      Noxu Media Group — 
dia

Position:     Full-time, remote

Location:     Philippines preferred (open to Southeast Asia)

Salary:       $1,000 – $1,500 USD/month based on experience

Hours:        8 hours/day, flexible — 2 hrs EST overlap preferred

Start date:   June 2026 — immediate start preferred

 

 

ABOUT NOXU MEDIA GROUP

-----------------------

Noxu Media Group is a digital media company that builds, grows, and operates

a portfolio of premium social media accounts across multiple platforms and

niches. We are not a marketing agency. We don't manage clients' accounts or

run paid campaigns. We own audiences — and we give brands direct access to them.

 

Our first account, Hale & Mora Estates, launching in June 2026. This is a global

luxury real estate editorial account with a distinctive voice and approach. More

accounts follow across travel, wellness, entrepreneurship, and lifestyle.

 

We are small, lean, and moving fast.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

-----------------

Every day you will be responsible for keeping multiple accounts publishing

consistently across all platforms. Specifically:

 

— Source 15–20 pieces of visual content daily across 5 accounts — property

  listings, press kits, editorial publications, and AI-generated renders

— Design branded graphics and carousel slides in Canva Pro using pre-built

  templates

— Edit short-form videos and Reels in CapCut Pro — property tours, price

  reveals, voiceover-led formats

— Write captions, hooks, and hashtag sets using Claude or ChatGPT, applying

  character voice guidelines for each account

— Schedule all content across platforms using Buffer or Metricool

— Add branded watermarks to all images before posting

— Reply to every comment within 2 hours during your working day

— Log all content in a Google Sheets content calendar

— Send a weekly performance report every Friday

 

You will also have genuine creative input. If you spot a format performing well,

bring it to us. If something is not working, say so. We want someone who thinks,

not just someone who executes.

 

 

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

------------------------

— 2+ years hands-on social media content experience — real account growth,

  not just scheduling

— Fluent in Canva Pro, CapCut Pro, and Buffer or Metricool without needing

  training

— Experience with or willingness to learn Midjourney for AI image generation

— Understands what makes content perform — saves and shares matter more than

  likes, and you know why

— Strong written English — captions must be clean, on-brand, and compelling

— Reliable and proactive — you flag problems early, you don't go quiet

— Comfortable managing multiple accounts simultaneously

 

STRONG BONUS: you run your own Instagram or TikTok account. Please share it

in your application. Someone who grows their own audience understands the

algorithm in a way that cannot be taught.

 

 

TOOLS YOU MUST KNOW

--------------------

Content design:   Canva Pro — templates, carousels, watermarks, brand kit

Video editing:    CapCut Pro — Reels, TikToks, text overlays, transitions

AI images:        Midjourney — property renders, concept visuals

Scheduling:       Buffer or Metricool — multi-platform scheduling

AI writing:       Claude or ChatGPT — caption drafting in character voice

Organisation:     Google Sheets, Google Drive — calendar and reporting

Communication:    Slack or WhatsApp — daily updates

 

 

WHAT WE OFFER

--------------

— Starting at $1,000 USD/month based on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise

— Up to $1,500 USD/month for the right candidate

— 13th month bonus paid in December — we honour this as standard

— Fully remote — no office, no commute

— Real creative ownership — you help shape accounts from zero followers upward

— Clear growth path — senior roles open as the team expands

— Direct access to the founder — small team, flat structure

 

 

COMPANY PROFIT SHARING PROGRAMME

----------------------------------

Once Noxu Media accounts reach growth milestones, a profit sharing pool is

activated and shared proportionally across all active tea
mbers:

 

  Milestone 1 — any account reaches 10,000 followers:

  Pool activates at 5% of monthly net profit

 

  Milestone 2 — any account reaches 50,000 followers:

  Pool increases to 10% of monthly net profit

 

Individual amounts depend on team size and company profitability at the time.

We communicate the numbers transparently every month. This is a genuine share

in what we build together — not a token gesture.

 

 

TEAM GROWTH ROADMAP

--------------------

Phase 1 (now):          1 content VA — you — building all 5 accounts from zero

Phase 2 (~50K follows): Video specialist VA joins

Phase 3 (~100K follows):Sales VA joins for brand partnership outreach

Phase 4 (500K+):        Full team with senior roles and expanded profit sharing

 

The person hired now has first consideration for any senior role as we grow.

We prefer to promote from within.

 

 

YOUR FIRST ACCOUNT — HALE & MORA ESTATES

-----------------------------------------


 — luxury real estate editorial, global

Voice:        Victor Hale (52) and Isabelle Mora (31) — editorial curators

Content:      Property reveals, price comparisons, architectural analysis

Platforms:    Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, Pinterest

Posting:      2x per day, every day

Format split: 60% Reels, 30?rousels, 10% static

 

Full account brief, voice guides, Canva templates, content calendar, and

workflow documentation are provided on your first day.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

-------------

*** START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORD NOXU AT THE VERY TOP ***

Applications that do not include this word will not be read.

 

In your application, please tell us:

 

— Your experience with social media content creation — niches, platforms,

  results

— The tools you use daily and your honest skill level with each

— Your personal Instagram or TikTok handle if you run one — share it

— One example of content you created that performed better than you expected,

  and why you think it worked

 

Keep it direct and specific. We read every application. We respond faster to

people who communicate with clarity and evidence.

 

Send your application to: 

 

 

ONE HONEST NOTE

----------------

This is a ground-floor role in a company being built right now. Month one is

setup — learning the workflow, building the content library, finding what

performs. Month three you should be running the full operation with minimal

daily oversight.

 

If you want a job where you follow a fixed task list and clock out at five,

this is not it. If you want to build something from the beginning, have real

creative input, and share in what it becomes — we want to hear from you.

 

 

Noxu Media Group

title: Sales Closer (Remote) — Web Design, SEO, PPC + Digital Services
description:
# Sales Closer (Remote) — Web Design, SEO, PPC + Digital Services



## About Us



Zino Web is a US-based digital marketing agency helping small and medium-sized businesses grow through professional website design, SEO, PPC advertising, and related marketing services.



We are looking for an experienced **Sales Closer** to join our remote team. This is not an appointment-setting role. You will speak with qualified prospects, understand their business needs, present our services, handle objections, follow up, and close deals.



## What You’ll Do



* Take booked sales calls from inbound leads and warm prospects

* Follow up with leads by
, phone, SMS, and CRM tasks

* Present Zino Web services clearly: web design, SEO, PPC, and marketing solutions

* Ask strong discovery questions and identify the client’s real business problem

* Handle objections around price, timing, trust, and decision-making

* Close deals and help move clients to onboarding

* Keep the CRM updated with notes, next steps, deal stage, and follow-up dates

* Stay responsive during your full shift

* Attend tea
etings, sales training, and role-play sessions



## Requirements



* Proven experience closing sales, preferably for digital marketing, websites, SEO, PPC, SaaS, or B2B services

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Confident on Zoom/Google Meet and phone calls

* Reliable internet connection

* Quality headset or microphone

* Quiet work environment

* Strong follow-up discipline

* Comfortable working with targets and commissions

* Available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Los Angeles time

* Must be responsive throughout the shift



## Nice-to-Haves



* Experience using HubSpot or similar CRM

* Experience selling to US business owners

* Knowledge of web design, SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, or marketing funnels

* Experience with Zoom, Google Meet, Slack, Gmail, and online calendars



## Schedule / Time Zone



* Monday to Friday

* 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time / Los Angeles time

* Full-time remote role

* You must be comfortable working this shift consistently



## Pay / Benefits



* Base pay: **$500–$800/month**, depending on experience

* Commission: earned on closed deals after client payment is received

* Realistic commission structure: **3%–7% per closed sale**, based on package type and performance

* Performance reviews after training and every 60–90 days

* Long-term growth opportunity for strong closers



## KPIs We Track



* Follow-up speed: respond to new leads within 5–10 minutes during shift

* Show rate support: confirm calls and reduce no-shows

* Close rate on qualified calls

* CRM hygiene: all leads updated daily

* Follow-up completion rate

* Monthly closed revenue



## Training / Onboarding



We provide **1 month of paid training**. During training, you will learn our services, offers, sales process, CRM workflow, scripts, objection handling, and follow-up system.



Success looks like this:



**30 days:** You understand our services, scripts, CRM, and sales process.

**60 days:** You are confidently handling calls, following up, and closing smaller deals.

**90 days:** You are consistently closing qualified prospects and managing your pipeline independently.



## Do Not Apply If



* You only have appointment-setting experience and no closing experience

* You are not comfortable speaking with US business owners

* You cannot work 9 AM–5 PM Los Angeles time

* You are not responsive during work hours

* You have poor internet, background noise, or no quality headset

* You avoid CRM updates or follow-up tasks



## How to Apply



Send your application with the subject line:



**ZINO CLOSER**



Include the following:



* A short introduction about your sales experience

* A 1–2 minute voice recording link explaining why you are a good fit

* Your top 2 sales closes, including what you sold and the deal value

* Screenshot of your internet speed test

* Your expected monthly base pay

* Your availability in Pacific Time



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: Short Form Editor
description:
Shah Neurovision Sports Training (NeuroVision Edge) teaches athletes the vision and brain side of performance — reaction time, tracking, game IQ. We publish educational Reels on Instagram 
 28K+ followers and climbing). Our content is calm, credible, and genuinely useful — not hype, not motivational fluff. We're scaling our output on a clear path toward 1M followers, and the editor is the engine that makes that possible.

What you'll do

Edit 14–15 short-form videos per week — Instagram Reels, 30–60 seconds, from raw talking-head footage.

Cut podcast footage into Reels — pull standalone clips from our podcast episodes.

Add clean animated captions and text overlays, accurately synced to the audio.

Edit for retention — simple b-roll, zooms, and hard cuts that hold attention, especially in the first 3 seconds.

Build on-screen graphics — hook text, simple stat/drill callouts, and a closing “save this” card.

Light cleanup — basic color and audio so every video looks and sounds sharp.

Export to spec — 9:16, correct resolution, delivered on an agreed schedule.

Hold the format — keep a consistent look across every video using our template.

The format you'll work in

So you know exactly what you're signing up for: our Reels are not complex VFX projects. They're talking-head delivery, animated captions, athlete famous or current athlete events b-roll, and simple text graphics. The skill we care about is retention editing — pacing, cuts, and hook framing — not motion-design wizardry. Once you know our template, each video should be fast to turn around. We'll give you a clear style guide and example videos to match.

What we're looking for

2+ years editing short-form video (Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts).

A portfolio of short-form work — send your strongest Reels or TikToks.

Fast, accurate captioning and text-overlay skills.

Strong retention instincts — you understand hooks, pacing, and when to cut or zoom.

Tool proficiency — CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve.

Good written English — you'll be placing on-screen captions, so accuracy matters.

Reliable turnaround — you hit deadlines and flag issues early.

Self-directed — once you know the format, you run with minimal hand-holding.

Nice to have

Interest in or knowledge of sports.

explanatory motion graphics — animated text, simple lower-thirds.

Experience editing for educational or talking-head creators.

A feel for current short-form trends and audio conventions.

Logistics

Full-time, fully remote.

Compensation: based on experience. 

Hours: a few hours of overlap with US Pacific time for handoffs — otherwise flexible.

Ongoing, long-term role with room to grow as the channel scales.

Start: as soon as we find the right fit.

How to apply

Please do all three of these — applications missing the test edit won't be reviewed:

Send your portfolio — links to 3–5 short-form videos you personally edited.

Answer one question — in a sentence or two, tell us the single best hook you've ever cut, and why it worked.

Complete the paid test edit below.

The paid test edit

We respect your time, so the test is paid whether or not we move forward.

We'll send you one raw talking-head clip (about 60–90 seconds).

Edit it into a finished ~40-second Instagram Reel: animated captions, a strong hook treatment in the first 3 seconds, 2–3 simple b-roll or zoom 
nts, and a closing “save this” card.

Turn it around within 3 days.

We pay $30 USD for the completed test.
