title: Accountant
description:
We are an Australian financial advisory company seeking a highly capable Offshore Accountant to support our accounting operations. We are looking for someone with solid Australian company experience, strong attention to detail, and advanced hands-on experience using Xero platform. 



This role is ideal for an accountant who is confident working independently, understand Australian business and tax processes, and can deliver accurate, timely, and insightful financial support. 



Key Responsibilities: 

- Structure, manage, and track client or business rebates. 

- Process employee payments, including monthly and fortnightly payroll support. 

- Manage cash flow monitoring and reporting. 

- Perform bank reconciliations and general account reconciliation. 

- Support and coordinate audit requirements and documentation. 

- Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. 

- Assist with budgeting and forecasting activities. 

- Prepare management reports and provide financial insights. 

- Liaise with internal stakeholders and external parties on tax-related matters. 

- Maintain accurate financial records and ensure timely processing of transactions. 

- Identify process improvements to enhance finance efficiency and accuracy. 



Required Experience and Skills: 

- Proven experience working with Australian companies or within an Australian accounting/finance environment. 

- Strong practical experience using Xero, including reconciliations, AP/AR, reporting, and general ledger management. 

- Experience in payroll processing, including monthly and fortnightly payment cycles. 

- Solid understanding of core accounting processes, including reconciliations, cash flow, payables, and receivables. 

- Experience supporting audits and preparing finance-related documentation. 

- Good understanding of Australian business and finance practices. 

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. 

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 

- Ability to work remotely, manage deadlines, and maintain confidentiality. 



Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience in a professional services, financial advisory, accounting, or similar Australian business environment. 

- Exposure to Australian tax or compliance-related processes. 

- Accounting qualification, bookkeeping certification, or equivalent relevant experience. 

- Ability to provide financial insights beyond transactional processing. 



What We Are Looking For: 

- Reliable, proactive, and organised. 

- Comfortable working with an Australian team and Australian business standards. 

- Able to take ownership of finance tasks with minimal supervision. 

- Process-driven, accurate, and committed to meeting deadlines.

title: Full-Time Cold Caller & Lead Generation Specialist (8 hrs/day, 5 days/wk) – $3/hr + $15 Bonuses
description:
We are LatteLux LLC, a premium mobile coffee truck and corporate catering business based in Georgia, USA. We provide high-end espresso bar experiences for corporate events, warehouses, factories, film sets, and private celebrations. We are expanding our outreach and looking for a dedicated, results-driven Full-Time Female Cold Caller / Lead Generation Specialist to join our team.



Job Overview:

Type: Full-Time (8 hours per day, 5 days a week: Monday to Friday).



Rate: Fixed $3.00 per hour + HIGH performance bonuses.



Payment Schedule: Guaranteed weekly payouts every Single Monday via Wise/Remitly.



Tools Provided: We provide 4 verified US business phone numbers via OpenPhone and full access to premium B2B databases like Data Axle.



?? CRITICAL: Work Schedule & Time Zone Warning

Your daily calling shift is fixed and strictly set between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM EST (Eastern Standard Time / Georgia, USA time).

Before applying, you MUST check your local time zone to ensure you can comfortably and consistently work during these specific US business hours (for the Philippines, this is a night shift). Please make sure this fits your lifestyle.



???? UNCAPPED PERFORMANCE BONUSES (Earn Extra Cash!):

We highly value results and want you to grow with us.



We offer a generous $15.00 USD bonus for every single client you successfully close!



Bonus Condition: The bonus is fully earned and paid out once the client hires us and we execute the catering event for them.



No Limits: There is no cap on how many bonuses you can earn. Bring 10 clients — get an extra $150 added directly to your weekly pay!



Key Requirements:

Gender: Female.



Proven experience in B2B Cold Calling and Lead Generation (US market experience is a huge plus).



Flawless English with a neutral/clear accent and excellent communication skills.



Strong objection handling skills — you must be confident, polite, and persistent.



Highly organized and disciplined to manage high daily call volumes.



Your Daily Schedule & Workflow (8 hours total):

First 2-3 Hours (Lead Sourcing & Prep): You will use Data Axle to find and vet 240 leads for your workday. You will pre-populate them into our daily CRM Lead Tracking Sheet (Google Sheets) and create a brief report of the sourced work.



Next 5 Hours (9:00 AM - 2:00 PM EST - Cold Calling & Messaging): You will spend this exact window actively calling the sourced leads. Following up on calls, you will also send a pre-written message template (SMS/MMS) to every single number using the provided OpenPhone numbers.



Number Rotation: To prevent spam risk, you will rotate between the 4 provided OpenPhone numbers throughout your shift (approx. 50-60 calls per number).



Data Entry & Reporting Requirements:

You must maintain 100% accurate, real-time logging in our CRM Lead Tracking Sheet. For every single lead, you will document:



Company Name & Industry



Contact Person Name & Title (HR Manager, Event Coordinator, Facility Manager, etc.)



Phone Number &
 Address



Call Outcome / Disposition Status (e.g., No Answer, Refusal, Left Voi
, Appointment Scheduled).



HOW TO APPLY (Read Carefully):



Start your application message with the keyword: "LATTE".



Confirm that you are 100% available to work between 9:00 AM and 2:00 PM EST.



Provide a link to a Voice Sample / Audio Recording (you can use 
 or similar). Briefly introduce yourself and describe your B2B cold calling experience.
